To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we present the first variational formulation of non-rigid structure-from-motion (nrsfm); 2) we use the trace-norm to regularize the non-rigid shape matrix; 3) we use total-variation to regularize the shape in space; 4) we use proximal splitting techniques to solve the problem; and 5) we present results on a number of challenging real sequences.

(i) the proposed variational approach to dense 3D non-rigid surface reconstruction from monocular video outperforms state-of-the-art methods; and (ii) the proposed method is the first to use trace norm regularization to minimize the rank of non-rigid shapes directly, which is a significant contribution in its own right.
we propose a new variational method to reconstruct dense 3D non-rigid surfaces directly from video.
